title: Docs and design briefs still describe the audience with the retired persona trio and nervous-system framing
detail:
PR 9 (ADR-1715). Re-keys or supersedes every doc in the handoff's conflict sweep: CREATIVE-PLATFORM section 1 (superseded, core truth recast as being missed when you do not show up), MARKETING-AI, MARKETING-BRIEF, MARKETING-STYLE-GUIDE, ROADMAP, IA-STRATEGY, PUBLIC-SITE-PLAN (archetype rows and the missing doors), LEAD-FLOWS and SPLASH-FUNNELS (persona-to-family map), MARKETING-BUILD-PLAN, COMMUNITY-COLLECTIVE-STRATEGY, ROLES, and the design briefs (BRIEF-00, 02, 03, 04, dawn/readme, claude-design-briefs, funnels-brief) regenerated from the new section 2 and synced per design_handoff/SYNC.md.

CLOSED 2026-10-06. CREATIVE-PLATFORM section 1 is marked superseded and points to the canon, with the old personas mapped to archetypes; its core truth is recast as being missed when you don't show up and its nervous-system surface lines are gone. MARKETING-AI, MARKETING-BRIEF, MARKETING-STYLE-GUIDE, ROADMAP, IA-STRATEGY, MARKETING-BUILD-PLAN, COMMUNITY-COLLECTIVE-STRATEGY and ROLES name the two readers, families or archetypes in plain words. PUBLIC-SITE-PLAN gains the archetype table with the three missing doors named (Activity-First, Evidence-First, Mission Patron). LEAD-FLOWS documents the persona-to-family map and Vera's reader note; SPLASH-FUNNELS keys the planned demographic style on archetypes. Design briefs: BRIEF-02 section 1 regenerated from CONTENT-VOICE section 2, BRIEF-00's description, dawn/readme, BRIEF-03 and BRIEF-04 (business on the Builders side), claude-design-briefs Reader lines, funnels-brief, and two DAWN marketing kit lines. check:dawn-bundle stays green.
